title: sweep(spec): 2-item liveness-ledger follow-through sweep III — one claim, one PR, per-item checklist (#6774 #6773)
body:
Sweep card per the findings-round bundling discipline (#6243 / #7024 / #7056 precedents), packaged by the `domain:spec` seat under the maintainer's cloud-bundling approval (2026-08-09 「同意」, chat) and today's second batch-acceleration instruction (「又可以加速派一批了，包括云卡」). **This card is the claim object**; the member cards keep `pm:queue` but are NOT dispatch candidates while this sweep is open.

## Shared criterion

Both members are **liveness-ledger records that stopped being answerable to reality after objectui implementations landed** — follow-through corrections, not new judgments. The ledger is the evidence base for enforce-or-remove verdicts; a stale row/note mis-steers the next audit (the #5175 lesson, cited by both members' triage). **No acceptance-face changes**: the legal-metadata set is byte-identical before/after. (Member 1 additionally releases a pinned ADVISORY contrast — a test-expectation change on a CLI advisory face, not a schema acceptance change; assert exactly that.)

## Members (read each card + its full comment thread before touching it; premise-first per member)

1. **#6774** — `packages/spec/liveness/dashboard.json` `colorVariant` row flips **live** (objectui#3799 merged AND absorbed by the framework's `.objectui-sha` pin `09987b68` — the unlock sweep on the card verified `git merge-base --is-ancestor`; re-verify on current main). Plus: release PR #5255's pinned "exactly-one-warning colorVariant" positive contrast on the CLI advisory (its premise — renderer doesn't read the key — no longer holds), and correct any #5255-adjacent comments/fixtures still asserting "colorVariant never took effect". Refs on the card: #5010 ruling B, #5175.
2. **#6773** — `packages/spec/liveness/field.json:109` `Field.widget` note: replace `sys_permission_set (capability-multiselect)` with `sys_permission_set (permission-facet-link)`. The cross-pin measurements are already on the card (2026-08-09 comment): `capability-multiselect` was never registered on any live path and is now retired (objectui#3308 / PR #3793); the actual widget is `permission-facet-link`, registered at objectui `plugin-detail/src/index.tsx:563` on the current pin — verify that anchor read-only against `/home/user/objectui` at the pinned SHA and record the reading. Also spot-check the note's other widget names (`object-ref` / `filter-condition` / `recipient-picker`) are still in `fieldWidgetMap`.

## Sweep rules (binding on the PR)

- One PR, per-item checklist (落点 | before | after), `Fixes #6774` / `Fixes #6773` only for completed members; dropped member ⇒ `Part of` + evidence.
- **Zero changes outside the 2 items**; `git diff --stat` maps 1:1 onto the checklist.
- Existing schema acceptance tests pass unchanged; the released #5255 contrast is the only test-expectation change and belongs to member 1's row.
- Out-of-scope discoveries filed separately unassigned (PD #10).
- A dead premise drops the member with evidence — good outcome, not failure.

Refs: #6243 (pilot), #7024/#7056 (predecessors), #5175 (why ledger truth matters), #5010 (colorVariant ruling B).
